existing_group_assignments.rationale: Decreased plasma PGF2alpha concentration is the same reduction as the existing plasma member, with the same wording variant as the ovary-synthesis members.
Decreased sodium conductance 2 is related to the existing decreased sodium conductance 1 and sodium channel function events, for curator review.
Inhibition of deiodinase 3 is another deiodinase isoform alongside the existing isoform-specific inhibition events.

new_groups.rationale: Decreased vs increased T3 in tissues are opposite directions of the same endpoint.
